QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_50

question.text: Regulatory safeguards on Incentive Fee mis-alignment in AIFs include:

answer.text: Mandatory disclosure in PPM, clawback provisions, HWM and Hurdle thresholds, Sponsor continuing interest
Requiring SEBI approval for each fee payment

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 9 and SEBI regs: PPM disclosure, Clawback, HWM, Hurdle, and Sponsor skin-in-the-game all mitigate mis-alignment. No outright ban; no 5% cap; no per-payment approval. The Trap: Options B, C, D overstate the regulatory regime. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C (Compliance) covers these protections; XIX-C asks the manager to implement. Manager's Pro-Tip: The continuing interest rule (Sponsor commits 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore lower for Cat I/II) is non-negotiable. Track this through fund life — redemption/transfer of Sponsor units requires SEBI intimation.
